## 311 rodent complaints, 2018 - 2026

The data come from the NYC Open Data API, read with `GET()`, so anyone can rerun this file. The API returns only 1,000 rows by default, so we raise `$limit` and download one year at a time. 311 is split into two datasets: `76ig-c548` covers 2010-2019 and `erm2-nwe9` covers 2020 to present. We keep every complaint with complaint type "Rodent" and choose the descriptor ("Rat Sighting") later, so no category is lost.

### Function to download dataset

```{r download_function}
get_rodent_year = function(dataset_id, yr) {

  Sys.sleep(5)

  GET(
    paste0("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/", dataset_id, ".csv"),
    query = list(
      "$select" = "unique_key, created_date, descriptor, community_board, borough, location_type, latitude, longitude",
      "$where" = paste0(
        "complaint_type = 'Rodent' AND created_date >= '", yr,
        "-01-01T00:00:00' AND created_date < '", yr + 1, "-01-01T00:00:00'"
      ),
      "$limit" = "300000"
    )
  ) |>
    content("text") |>
    read_csv(col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
}
```

### Data import 

```{r download_data}
if (!file.exists("data/rodent_311.csv")) {

  dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

  rodent_2018_2019 =
    map(2018:2019, \(yr) get_rodent_year("76ig-c548", yr)) |>
    bind_rows()

  rodent_2020_2026 =
    map(2020:2026, \(yr) get_rodent_year("erm2-nwe9", yr)) |>
    bind_rows()

  rodent_raw = bind_rows(rodent_2018_2019, rodent_2020_2026)

  write_csv(rodent_raw, "data/rodent_311.csv")
}
```

### Data cleaning


311 writes community districts like "09 MANHATTAN", while PLUTO uses codes like 109. We convert them to PLUTO's format so the two datasets can be joined. We also drop the current month, which is incomplete.

```{r clean_data, message = FALSE}
last_full_month = lubridate::floor_date(Sys.Date(), "month")

nyc_rodent =
  read_csv("data/rodent_311.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  distinct(unique_key, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  separate(
    community_board,
    into = c("board_num", "board_boro"),
    sep = " ",
    extra = "merge",
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    created_date = as.Date(created_date),
    year = lubridate::year(created_date),
    month = lubridate::floor_date(created_date, "month"),
    board_num = as.numeric(board_num),
    boro_code = case_when(
      board_boro == "MANHATTAN" ~ 100,
      board_boro == "BRONX" ~ 200,
      board_boro == "BROOKLYN" ~ 300,
      board_boro == "QUEENS" ~ 400,
      board_boro == "STATEN ISLAND" ~ 500
    ),
    community_district = boro_code + board_num,
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  ) |>
  filter(month < last_full_month) |>
  select(
    unique_key, created_date, year, month, descriptor,
    borough, community_board, community_district, location_type, latitude, longitude
  )

## view dataset 

view(nyc_rodent)
```

The dataset has `r nrow(nyc_rodent)` rodent complaints from `r min(nyc_rodent$created_date)` to `r max(nyc_rodent$created_date)`.

### Type of rodent complaint

```{r complaint_type}
complaint_type =
  nyc_rodent |>
  group_by(year, descriptor) |>
  summarize(
    n = n_distinct(unique_key),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year)

complaint_type |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = descriptor,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Note: `r max(nyc_rodent$year)` is not a full year, so its totals are lower than other years.

### Type of rodent complaint plot

```{r complaint_type_plot, fig.width = 10, fig.asp = 0.5}
nyc_rodent |>
  mutate(descriptor = recode(descriptor, "Rodent Bite - PCS Only" = "Rodent Bite")) |>
  count(month, descriptor) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, color = descriptor)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly 311 rodent complaints by type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of complaints",
    color = "Complaint type"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

### Rat sightings

Rat sightings are our main outcome. The dashed lines mark when each trash bin rule took effect, according to the NYC Department of Sanitation (DSNY).

```{r rat_borough_plot, fig.width = 10, fig.asp = 0.5}
rat_sightings =
  nyc_rodent |>
  filter(descriptor == "Rat Sighting")

bin_rules =
  tibble(
    date = as.Date(c("2023-08-01", "2023-09-05", "2024-03-01", "2024-11-12")),
    rule = c("Food businesses", "Chain businesses", "All businesses", "1-9 unit buildings")
  )

rat_sightings |>
  filter(borough != "Unspecified", !is.na(borough)) |>
  count(borough, month) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, color = borough)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    data = bin_rules,
    aes(xintercept = date),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly 311 rat sightings by borough",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines: bin rules for food businesses (Aug 2023), chains (Sep 2023),\nall businesses (Mar 2024), and 1-9 unit buildings (Nov 2024)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of rat sightings",
    color = "Borough"
  )
```

### Seasonal patterns in rat sightings by borough

```{r rat_seasonality_plot, fig.width = 10, fig.asp = 0.5}
winters =
  tibble(
    start = as.Date(paste0(2017:2025, "-12-01")),
    end = as.Date(paste0(2018:2026, "-03-01"))
  )

rat_sightings |>
  filter(borough != "Unspecified", !is.na(borough)) |>
  count(borough, month) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, color = borough)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = winters,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "lightblue",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal patterns in rat sightings by borough",
    subtitle = "Shaded areas mark winter (December to February)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of rat sightings",
    color = "Borough"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Julian's code

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nyc_311_2020 = 
  read_csv("data/nyc_311_2020.csv") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(
    unique_key,
    created_date,
    problem_formerly_complaint_type, 
    problem_detail_formerly_descriptor, 
    location_type,
    incident_address,
    borough, 
    latitude,
    longitude
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    created_date = as.Date(lubridate::mdy_hms(created_date))
  )

# General view of data
view(nyc_311_2020)

#Summary based on types of 311 calls
descriptor_summary = 
  nyc_311_2020 |> 
   mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(created_date),
    complaint = problem_detail_formerly_descriptor
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2020,
    year <= 2026
  ) |>
  group_by(year, complaint) |>
  summarize(
    n = n_distinct(unique_key),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year)

#tidy readable table
descriptor_summary|>  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = complaint,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable()

#plots
descriptor_plot = 
  descriptor_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = complaint)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
descriptor_plot
```
